tagline: Eight islands, no bridges, no ferry — the only U.S. state where the islands don't connect.
summary: Hawaiʻi is the most isolated populated archipelago on Earth and the only U.S. state with no inter-island road, bridge or scheduled passenger ferry. Moving between Oʻahu, Maui, Kauaʻi and Hawaiʻi Island means flying — short, frequent, carbon-heavy hops that congest island airports. A clean foiling sea tier is the inter-island layer Hawaiʻi has never had.
why_marine_mobility: The Hawaiian story is the channels between the islands. The state retired its only inter-island ferry in 2009, leaving aviation as the sole option for trips that are often shorter by water than the airport experience around them. Navier's Quanta-LR range spans the inter-island channels; the Pioneer II serves the shorter coastal and resort legs — together restoring a sea connection the islands lost, this time clean and stabilised.

demand_signals.label: No inter-island ferry
demand_signals.note: Hawaiʻi has had no scheduled inter-island passenger ferry since the Superferry ceased in 2009 — a structural gap in the state's mobility.

demand_signals.label: Inter-island visitor flow
demand_signals.note: Millions of annual visitors move between islands almost entirely by air, clogging regional airports for trips of well under 100 nautical miles.

demand_signals.label: Clean-energy mandate
demand_signals.note: Hawaiʻi targets 100% renewable energy by 2045; a zero-direct-emission foiling tier aligns directly with state climate policy.

use_cases.body: Oʻahu (Ko Olina) to Maui (Maalaea): the marquee inter-island corridor, flown clean on Quanta-LR — restoring the sea link the islands lost in 2009.
Oʻahu to Kauaʻi: a Quanta-LR channel crossing connecting Honolulu to the Garden Isle without an airport on either end of a short hop.
Maui to Hawaiʻi Island (Kawaihae): a resort-and-leisure channel run on the long-range hybrid tier as range comes online.

navier_fit.pioneer_ii: Coastal and shorter resort legs (Kona–Kawaihae and intra-island runs) sit inside Pioneer II's 70-nautical-mile range — commercial-ready today.
navier_fit.quanta_lr: The inter-island channels (Oʻahu–Maui ~72 nm, Oʻahu–Kauaʻi ~93 nm, Maui–Hawaiʻi Island ~80 nm) are Quanta-LR corridors (~700 nm hybrid range, H2 2026+), aligned with the state's renewable-energy goals.

signature_routes.label: Oʻahu (Ko Olina) ↔ Maui (Maalaea) — the marquee inter-island corridor
Honolulu (Oʻahu) ↔ Kauaʻi — the Garden Isle channel crossing
Maui ↔ Hawaiʻi Island (Kawaihae) — the Big Island channel

transit_planning: For the state and county authorities: a clean, fast inter-island sea tier that relieves congested regional airports, restores a passenger sea link absent since 2009, and advances the 2045 renewable-energy mandate. Begin with the proven Oʻahu–Maui corridor on Quanta-LR as range matures, with Pioneer II serving coastal and resort legs now. Note: Lahaina is rebuilding after the 2023 fire — Maui operations stage through Maalaea Harbor.
competitive_landscape: Inter-island travel is effectively an aviation monopoly since the Superferry's 2009 closure — frequent but carbon-heavy, airport-bound, and ill-suited to short channel hops. There is no clean sea alternative. Navier's foiling tier reintroduces the sea connection with none of the wake and emissions concerns that grounded the prior ferry.
regulatory_note: Inter-island marine passenger service intersects the U.S. Coast Guard, the State of Hawaiʻi Department of Transportation (Harbors Division), and county harbor authorities; the Superferry's history makes environmental review (wake, marine-life, harbor impact) a central early consideration — areas where a low-wake foiling craft has a strong story.
seasonality: Summer (Apr–Oct) brings the calmest channels; winter (Nov–Mar) raises north-swell and trade-wind seas in the inter-island channels — conditions where a stabilised foiling vessel holds schedule far better than a conventional hull.

precedents.what: Four Seasons Lake Austin operates an N30 in live U.S. luxury-hospitality service — domestic proof of the premium clean water-shuttle model.
